```xml
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  id="definitions"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn">

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_1">
    <bpmn:participant id="ORG" name="Organisation" processRef="Process_1" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_1" isExecutable="false">
    <!-- Lanes -->
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_1">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Employee" name="Employee">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Purchase</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>SubmitReport</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EmployeeEdit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Supervisor" name="Supervisor">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>ReviewReport</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>ApproveGateway</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Treasurer" name="Treasurer">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>CheckReceipts</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>ReceiptsGateway</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>AcceptProcessing</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>SendBack</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_PaymentSystem" name="Payment System">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>AutoLink</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>WaitConfirmation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <!-- Flow nodes -->
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start" name="Start expense process" />

    <bpmn:task id="Purchase" name="Purchase product or service" />
    <bpmn:task id="SubmitReport" name="Submit expense report" />
    <bpmn:task id="ReviewReport" name="Supervisor reviews expense report" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="ApproveGateway" name="Supervisor approves?" />

    <bpmn:task id="EmployeeEdit" name="Employee edits expense report" />

    <bpmn:task id="CheckReceipts" name="Treasurer checks receipts" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="ReceiptsGateway" name="All receipts in order?" />
    <bpmn:task id="AcceptProcessing" name="Treasurer accepts expenses for processing" />
    <bpmn:task id="SendBack" name="Treasurer sends back report" />

    <bpmn:task id="AutoLink" name="Automatic payment system link" />
    <bpmn:task id="WaitConfirmation" name="Wait for payment confirmation" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End" name="Process ends" />

    <!-- Sequence flows -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F1" sourceRef="Start" targetRef="Purchase" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F2" sourceRef="Purchase" targetRef="SubmitReport" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F3" sourceRef="SubmitReport" targetRef="ReviewReport" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F4" sourceRef="ReviewReport" targetRef="ApproveGateway" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F5" sourceRef="ApproveGateway" targetRef="CheckReceipts">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">approved</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F6" sourceRef="ApproveGateway" targetRef="EmployeeEdit">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">rejected</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F7" sourceRef="EmployeeEdit" targetRef="ReviewReport" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F8" sourceRef="CheckReceipts" targetRef="ReceiptsGateway" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F9" sourceRef="ReceiptsGateway" targetRef="AcceptProcessing">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">all_ok</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F10" sourceRef="ReceiptsGateway" targetRef="SendBack">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">missing_or_mismatch</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F11" sourceRef="SendBack" targetRef="EmployeeEdit" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F12" sourceRef="AcceptProcessing" targetRef="AutoLink" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F13" sourceRef="AutoLink" targetRef="WaitConfirmation" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F14" sourceRef="WaitConfirmation" targetRef="End" />

  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
```
